spans.s:
ऊर्ध ऊर्ध and ऊर्धक, a wrong reading
for ऊर्ध्व and ऊर्ध्वक.

ऊर्ध्व ऊर्ध्व, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. वृध्), rising
upwards, tending upwards, raised, elevated, erected,
erect, upright; being above; above, high, superior,
upper. In classical Sanskrit an example of the un-
compounded adjective as in ऊर्ध्वैः पादैः, ‘with
raised feet,’ is rare. (अम्), n. elevation, height, any-
thing situated above; (अम्), ind. upwards, towards
the upper part, aloft, above, in the upper regions, on
the upper side of (with abl.); in the sequel (as of a
book, the upper leaves of a MS. being read last);
subsequent, after (with abl.); in a high tone, aloud;
ऊर्ध्वं द्वितीयाद् अचः, after the second vowel;
ऊर्ध्वम् पितुः, after the father's death; संवत्-
सराद् ऊर्ध्वम्, after a year; अत ऊर्ध्वम्, hence-
forward, from that time forward, hereafter; ऊर्ध्वं
गम्, to go upwards, to die; [cf. Gr. ὀρθός; Lat.
arduus; Gaël. ard.]
—ऊर्ध्व-कच, अस्, m. an
epithet of Ketu (whose hair streams upwards in the
sky).
—ऊर्ध्व-कण्ठ, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people;
(ई), f., N. of a plant.
—ऊर्ध्व-कर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्,
having the ears pricked up or erect.
—ऊर्ध्व-
कर्मन्, अ, n. motion or action tending upwards;
(आ), m., N. of a Viṣṇu (going upwards).
—ऊर्ध्व-
काय, अस्, m. the upper part of the body.
—ऊर्ध्व-
कृशन, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. effervescing, fermenting;
epithet of the Soma; (Sāy.) having its sharp qualities
stirred up.
—ऊर्ध्व-केतु, उस्, m., N. of a son of
Sanad-rāja.
—ऊर्ध्व-केश, अस्, आ, अम्, having the
hair erect.
—ऊर्ध्व-क्रिया, f. motion or action tend-
ing upwards.
—ऊर्ध्व-ग, अस्, आ, अम्, going upwards,
ascending, hovering; being on high.
—ऊर्ध्व-गत,
अस्, आ, अम्, gone up, risen, ascended.
—ऊर्ध्व-गति,
इस्, इस्, इ, going upwards; (इस्), f. ascent, elevation.
—ऊर्ध्वग-पुर, अम्, n. the city of Hariścandra,
who with his subjects is supposed to be suspended
in the atmosphere.
—ऊर्ध्व-गम, अस्, m. upward
motion of any kind.
—ऊर्ध्व-गमन, अम्, n. going
upwards, ascending; elevation in the scale of being.
—ऊर्ध्व-गामिन्, ई, इनी, इ, going up or above,
ascending.
—ऊर्ध्व-ग्रावन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. raising
the stones to press out the Soma plant.
—ऊर्ध्व-
चरण, अस्, आ, अम्, supine, having the feet upwards.
—ऊर्ध्व-चित्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. piling up, heaping up.
—ऊर्ध्व-जानु, उस्, उस्, उ, or ऊर्ध्व-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्,
or ऊर्ध्व-ज्ञु, उस्, उस्, उ, raising the knees, sitting on
the hams; long-shanked.
—ऊर्ध्व-तिलकिन्, ई, इनी, इ,
having a sectarian mark on the forehead.
—ऊर्ध्व-
त्व, अम्, n. or ऊर्ध्व-ता, f. height, elevation.
—ऊर्ध्-
व-था or ऊर्ध्व-धा, ind., Ved. upwards, erect.
—ऊर्ध्व-दंष्ट्रा-केश, अस्, m. whose teeth and
hair are erect; an epithet of Śiva.
—ऊर्ध्व-दृष्टि,
[]
इस्, इस्, इ, looking upwards, of high views, aspiring.
—ऊर्ध्व-देव, अस्, m. a superior deity; an epithet
of Viṣṇu.
—ऊर्ध्व-देह, अम्, n. (‘the body gone
above’), a funeral ceremony.
—ऊर्ध्व-नभस्, आस्,
आस्, अस्, Ved. being above in the clouds.
—ऊर्ध्वन्-
दम, अस्, आ, अम्, going upwards, erected, exalted,
elevated; (perhaps a wrong reading for ऊर्ध्वन्-
गम.)
—ऊर्ध्व-पथ, अस्, m. the upper region,
the ether.
—ऊर्ध्व-पातन, अम्, n. causing to
ascend, sublimation.
—ऊर्ध्व-पात्र, अम्, n. a sacri-
ficial vessel.
—ऊर्ध्व-पाद, अस्, आ, अम्, heels up-
wards; (अस्), m. a fabulous animal with eight legs;
see शरभ.
—ऊर्ध्व-पुण्ड्र or ऊर्ध्व-पुण्ड्र-
क, अम्, n. a perpendicular line on the forehead of a
Brāhman made with sandal &c., a Vaiṣṇaya mark.
—ऊर्ध्व-पूरम्, ind. full to the brim, full to over-
flowing.
—ऊर्ध्व-पृश्नि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. spotted
above.
—ऊर्ध्व-बर्हिस्, इस्, इस्, इस्, Ved. being over
the sacrificial grass.
—ऊर्ध्व-बाल, अस्, आ, अम्,
having the hair erect.
—ऊर्ध्व-बाहु, उस्, उस्, उ,
having the arms raised; (उस्), m. a devotee who
holds his arms above his head constantly till they are
fixed in that position; N. of one of the seven Ṛṣis
of the fifth Manvantara; one of the seven Ṛṣis of
the south; one of the seven sons of Vasiṣṭha.
—ऊर्ध्व-बुध्न, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. bottom upwards,
upside down.
—ऊर्ध्व-बृहती, f., N. of a metre.
—ऊर्ध्व-भाग, अस्, m. the upper part; any part
of a word coming after another part.
—ऊर्ध्व-भाज्,
क्, क्, क्, partaking of the upper part; a N. of Baḍa-
vāgni or submarine fire.
—ऊर्ध्व-मन्थिन्, living
in perpetual chastity; see ऊर्ध्व-रेतस्.
—ऊर्ध्व-
मान, अम्, n. an instrument for measuring altitudes.
—ऊर्ध्व-मायु, उस्, उस्, उ, giving forth a loud
noise.
—ऊर्ध्व-मारुत, अम्, n. pressure of the
wind (of the body) upwards.
—ऊर्ध्व-मुख, अस्,
ई, अम्, having the mouth or opening turned upwards.
—ऊर्ध्व-मौहूर्तिक, अस्, ई, अम्, happening after
a short time.
—ऊर्ध्व-रेखा-शवल, अस्, आ, अम्,
variegated with lines above.
—ऊर्ध्व-रेतस्, आस्, आस्,
अस्, ‘having the semen above,’ abstaining from sexual
intercourse, one who lives in perpetual chastity; a N.
of Śiva, also of Bhīṣma.
—ऊर्ध्व-रोमन्, आ, आ, अ,
having the hairs of the body erect; N. of a mountain.
—ऊर्ध्व-लिङ्ग, अस्, m., N. of Śiva.
—ऊर्ध्व-
लोक, अस्, m. the upper world, the world above,
heaven.
—ऊर्ध्व-वर्त्मन्, आ, m. the atmosphere,
heaven.
—ऊर्ध्व-वात, अस्, m. or ऊर्ध्व-वायु,
उस्, m. the wind in the upper part of the body.
—ऊर्ध्व-वृत, अस्, आ, अम्, put on above, put on
over the head or shoulder (as the sacred thread of
the Brāhman).
—ऊर्ध्व-शायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, sleeping
upright; epithet of Śiva.
—ऊर्ध्व-शोधन, अम्,
n. ‘purifying upwards,’ i. e. vomiting.
—ऊर्ध्व-शो-
षम्, ind. so as to dry (anything) above.
—ऊर्ध्व-
श्वास, अस्, m. expiration.
—ऊर्ध्व-सानु, उस्, उस्, उ,
Ved. carrying the neck high, with lofty or uplifted
neck; (Sāy.) rising higher and higher.
—ऊर्ध्व-
स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, being above, superior, situated on
high.
—ऊर्ध्व-स्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, being or standing
above.
—ऊर्ध्व-स्थिति, इस्, f. the rearing of a horse;
a horse's back, the part where the rider sits; eleva-
tion, superiority.
—ऊर्ध्व-स्रोतस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, N. of
a creation of beings whose stream of life or current
of nutriment tends upwards.
—ऊर्ध्वाङ्गुलि (˚व-
अङ्˚), इस्, इस्, इ, with raised finger.
—ऊर्ध्वाम्नाय-
संहिता (˚व-आम्˚), f. the doctrines of a particular
Vaiṣṇava sect.
—ऊर्ध्वायन (˚व-अय्˚), आस्, m. pl.,
N. of a caste in Plaksha-dvīpa.
—ऊर्ध्वावर्त (˚व-
आव्˚), अस्, m. rearing of a horse.
—ऊर्ध्वासित
(˚व-आस्˚), अस्, m. the plant Momordica Charantia.
—ऊर्ध्वेह (˚व-ईह), अस्, m. motion or tendency
upwards.
ऊर्ध्वक अस्, m. a kind of drum.

ऊर्ध्वसान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. rising, erecting
one's self.

ऊर्ध्वी-कृ, cl. 5. 8. P. A. -कृणोति, -णुते, -करोति,
-कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to raise aloft, to elevate.
